sentences.text:
Anil Kumar Prasad vs The State Of Jharkhand on 18 September,
2023
Author: Subhash Chand

Bench: Subhash Chand
 In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
 Cr. Revision No. 1148 of 2022
 Anil Kumar Prasad .... ... Petitioner
 Versus
 1. The State of Jharkhand.
 2. Vidya Devi .... ...

entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opp. Parties
Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Subhash Chand

For the Petitioner : Mrs. Vani Kumari,
Advocate.

For the State : Mr. Santosh Kumar Shukla, A.P.P. For the O.P.No.2 : Mr. Nehru Mahto,
Advocate.

--------
Order No. 10/ dated 18.09.2023 Learned Counsel Mrs. Vani Kumari on behalf of the petitioner and
on behalf of State, learned A.P.P. and also on behalf of O.P.No.2, learned Counsel Mr. Nehru Mahto
are present.
2.

By way of this Cr. Revision, the impugned Judgment dated 30.07.2022 in Cr. Appeal No. 11 of 2022 passed by the learned Addl. Sessions Judge-I, Ramgarh whereby the appeal was dismissed and the Judgment of conviction and sentence dated 15.02.2022 passed by the learned Sub-Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Ramgarh in G.R.No.3779 of 2015, arising out of Mandu (West Bokaro) P.S. Case No. 349 of 2015 was affirmed wherein the petitioner was held guilty for the offence under Section 498A IPC and Section 4 of the D.P. Act and was sentenced to undergo Rigorous Imprisonment for three years for the offence under section 498(A) of I.P.C. and fine of Rs.5,000/- and for one year R.I.
for the offence under Section 4 of D.P. Act and fine of Rs.5,000/-.
In default of payment of fine the petitioner has been sentenced to further undergo simple imprisonment for three months.

3. The learned Counsel for the petitioner and the learned Counsel for the O.P.No.2 have jointly submitted that a compromise has arrived between the parties during the Mediation Proceedings before JHALSA.
The report of the Mediator, JHASLA is on record.
The compromise is made part of the same.

This compromise is dated 27.02.2022.
4.
As jointly submitted by the learned Counsel for the parties, all the terms and conditions of the compromise have been complied with by the parties.
No dispute is left and submitted to dispose of this Cr. Revision in view of the compromise.

6. The impugned Judgment of conviction and sentence dated 15.02.2022 passed by the Judicial Magistrate, 1 st Class, Ramgarh in G.R. No.3779 of 2015 which was affirmed by the Appellate Court are hereby set aside.
7. The compromise dated 27.02.2023 which has arrived between the parties shall be the integral part of this order.
